title: Final gate lacks the dirty-stamp fail-close test that the boundary gate has (passed=False verdict stamp)
detail: Boundary gate pins the dirty-stamp direction at both gate level (:176) and finalize level (:340); the parallel final-gate classes (:299, :381) test only clean-stamp, no-stamp, and passed=True-with-violations. The final gate's dirty-stamp fail-close runs the same fall-through branch as its tested no-stamp case, so risk is low — but the W2 safety direction is unpinned for the final gate.
recommended_fix: Add test_dirty_stamp_does_not_prevent_abort to TestFinalGateDefensiveCrossCheck and test_none_review_with_dirty_stamp_fail_closes to TestFinalizeFinalGateCrossCheck, mirroring the boundary classes (:176, :340) with judge_kind 'final'.
